title: Local-Frame Rotary Attention for Antibody-Specific Epitope Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.01092v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Antibody-specific epitope prediction aims to identify which antigen residues are recognized by a given antibody, a task that depends on the three-dimensional complementarity between antibody CDRs and the antigen surface. Existing methods usually leverage PLM embeddings and inject structure through additional graph, surface, or point-cloud encoders, where the positional mechanism inside attention remains largely tied to one-dimensional sequence order. For proteins, the analogue of a token offset is not only sequence separation, but also the three-dimensional displacement between residues after folding. This raises a question, can folded residue geometry serve as the positional mechanism of attention itself? translated_title: 局部坐标系旋转注意力用于抗体特异性表位预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01092v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：抗体特异性表位预测旨在识别给定抗体所识别的抗原残基，这一任务依赖于抗体互补决定区（CDR）与抗原表面之间的三维互补性。现有方法通常利用蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入，并通过额外的图、表面或点云编码器注入结构信息，而注意力内部的位置机制在很大程度上仍然与一维序列顺序绑定。对于蛋白质而言，token偏移的对应概念不仅是序列间隔，还包括折叠后残基之间的三维位移。这引出了一个问题：折叠后的残基几何能否直接作为注意力本身的位置机制？我们提出局部坐标系旋转注意力（LFRA），它在由主链定义的局部坐标系中表达残基间的位移，并将其直接注入旋转注意力。该设计在保持连续的方向性几何信息的同时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出局部坐标系旋转注意力（LFRA），将主链局部坐标系下的残基间三维位移直接注入旋转注意力，以取代传统一维序列位置机制，从而提升抗体特异性表位预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Local-Frame Rotary Attention (LFRA), which directly injects inter-residue 3D displacements expressed in backbone-defined local frames into rotary attention, replacing conventional 1D sequence-based positional mechanisms to improve antibody-specific epitope prediction.
